description: Create all page components, domain-specific components (agents, tasks, org, governance, evolution, activity, charts), wire up React Router, and produce the complete App.tsx with routing. Also create dashboard/README.md.
steps: Create src/components/charts/ - CostChart.tsx (line chart using Recharts for cost over time), TaskPieChart.tsx (pie chart for task status distribution), PerformanceChart.tsx (bar chart for agent performance)

Create src/components/agents/ - AgentCard.tsx (summary card with name, role, department, status dot, current task, model), AgentList.tsx (grid/list toggle with filter controls), AgentDetail.tsx (tabbed detail view: Overview/Tasks/Memory/Performance/Configuration), AgentCreate.tsx (form for hiring new agent)

Create src/components/tasks/ - TaskCard.tsx (title, assigned agent, priority badge, status, date), TaskList.tsx (list with filters by project/agent/status/priority), TaskDetail.tsx (full task detail with result/error)
Create src/components/org/ - OrgChart.tsx (tree layout with CEO at top, departments, teams, agents), DepartmentCard.tsx (department summary with agent count), TeamCard.tsx (team summary)

Create src/components/governance/ - ApprovalCard.tsx (action description, requesting agent, risk level, approve/reject buttons), ApprovalList.tsx (list of pending approvals), BudgetMeter.tsx (gauge showing used/remaining budget)

Create src/components/evolution/ - ProposalCard.tsx (type, description, impact, confidence, risk, approve/reject), ProposalList.tsx (list of proposals), EvolutionTimeline.tsx (timeline of past evolutions)
Create src/components/activity/ - ActivityFeed.tsx (real-time activity stream with polling), ActivityItem.tsx (single activity entry with relative timestamp)
Create src/pages/Dashboard.tsx - main overview with 4 stat cards, CostChart, TaskPieChart, activity feed, top agents list
Create src/pages/Agents.tsx - agent management with AgentList, hire button
Create src/pages/AgentDetailPage.tsx - wraps AgentDetail with route params
Create src/pages/Tasks.tsx - task management with kanban columns or list view toggle
Create src/pages/Organization.tsx - org chart page with OrgChart and department cards
Create src/pages/Goals.tsx - goals and strategy view
Create src/pages/Skills.tsx - skills registry browser
Create src/pages/Tools.tsx - tools and integrations page
Create src/pages/Memory.tsx - memory/knowledge browser with search, scope filter, tier indicator
Create src/pages/Approvals.tsx - pending approvals center with ApprovalList
Create src/pages/Budgets.tsx - budget overview with BudgetMeter, per-department bars, per-agent cost table, cost chart
Create src/pages/Evolution.tsx - self-evolution monitor with ProposalList and EvolutionTimeline
Create src/pages/Workflows.tsx - active workflows with progress bars and delegation chains
Create src/pages/Meetings.tsx - meeting management page
Create src/pages/Activity.tsx - full activity log page
Create src/pages/Settings.tsx - system settings page
Create src/App.tsx with React Router v7 BrowserRouter, all routes defined, Layout wrapping all pages
Create dashboard/README.md explaining how to install, run dev server, and build for production
acceptance_criteria: All 16 page components exist in src/pages/
All domain component directories (agents, tasks, org, governance, evolution, activity, charts) exist with their components
App.tsx defines routes for every page using React Router v7
Dashboard page uses stat cards, charts, activity feed, and top agents
All components use TypeScript with proper Props interfaces
Layout component wraps all page routes
README.md exists with setup and run instructions
Design system colors are used consistently (indigo primary, dark sidebar, etc.)
verification: Verify all files exist: ls -R dashboard/src/pages/ dashboard/src/components/
Check App.tsx imports all pages and defines routes
Verify Dashboard.tsx uses chart components and stat cards
Check README.md exists and contains dev/build instructions
